headlines.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as CEO of Nvidia
headlines.description: Nvidia's board of directors announced that Jensen Huang has been reinstated as its president and chief executive officer. NBC News' Jared Perlo reports on the scandal that caused Huang's original resignation and the decision to return him to the role.

headlines.title: System Outages, Weather Issues Impact Thanksgiving Travel
headlines.description: Thanksgiving week is off to a messy start with weather and air travel issues impacting hundreds of flights. The FAA had to briefly shut down Delta flights to Atlanta’s Hartsfield-Jackson Airport on Sunday morning after an outage involving one of the airline’s calculation systems, coming on the heels of November’s nationwide ground stop. NBC’s Stephanie Gosk reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Trump postpones planned detonation of toxic drums at Iowa army facility
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said Monday he had ordered the Army not to go forward with the planned detonation of a Iowa bunker filled with drums of lead azide until the courts weigh in.

headlines.title: Ukrainian naval drone sinks Russian warship off the coast of Libya
headlines.description: President Zelenskyy said Ukrainian naval drones sunk the Russian warship Merkury off the coast of Libya. Video posted to the Ukrainian leader’s social media accounts shows a series of massive explosions as drones appear to approach the ship.

headlines.title: ICE Officers Arrest 2 Passenger Boarding Flight, Sparking Outrage
headlines.description: Distressing video shows two passengers, a father and his adult daughter, being arrested while boarding a flight in Seattle over the weekend, with the masked agents forcibly removing them from the jetbridge. The encounter is now prompting sharp rebukes from several local and state officials. NBC’s Dana Griffin reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: 2026 Rockefeller Center Christmas Tree Arrives in New York City
headlines.description: A magnificent Norway spruce has made its journey from West Edmeston, New York, to Rockefeller Center. The tree will undergo a glow-up ahead of the lighting ceremony on Dec. 2.

headlines.description: President Donald Trump said Monday he had ordered the Army not to go forward with the planned detonation of a Iowa bunker filled with drums of lead azide until the courts weigh in.

headlines.title: Congress reacts with anger and skepticism about Jensen Huang reinstatement
headlines.description: The stock market was thrilled with the announcement that Jensen Huang was returning as CEO of Nvidia, but lawmakers on both sides of the aisle reacted with shock — and said they still expect him to answer questions next week on Capitol Hill.

headlines.title: U.S. Army veteran mauled to death by pack of dogs in Georgia
headlines.description: A Georgia family on Monday was preparing to bury an Army veteran and mother of three who was mauled to death last week by a pack of dogs.

headlines.title: Bo Derek and John Corbett adopted Gene Hackman’s dog, Bear, after actor’s death
headlines.description: Hollywood power couple Bo Derek and John Corbett adopted Gene Hackman’s dog after the actor and his wife were found dead last year at their New Mexico home.

headlines.title: Sheila Mangubat, ‘90 Day Fiancé’ star, dies at 35
headlines.description: Sheila Mangubat, a fan favorite cast member of reality TV hit “90 Day Fiancé: Before the 90 Days,” has died, according to her former husband-to-be and a family member.

headlines.title: Trump says he spoke ‘directly and indirectly’ with Nvidia’s board about reinstating Jensen Huang
headlines.description: President Donald Trump said he spoke with Nvidia’s board members about reinstating Jensen Huang as CEO, telling CNBC on Monday morning that he sought to provide assurances to address their concerns about national security.
